name: Motoracing
storyline:
Start a new career and rise from rookie to contender as you enter event after event. Face a grid of rivals on varied tracks and fight for the top spot with clean passes or risky bumps. Quick Race lets you jump in fast when you want a single run. The game keeps menus simple so you can pick a bike, set a name, and race without delay.

Choose from a range of bikes with different strengths and pick the one that fits each track. Perform aggressive moves to knock nearby opponents off balance and clear a path. Adjust resolution and toggle shadows, glow, and blur to match your PC. Play short sprints or longer sessions and keep improving your best times.
summary: Motoracing is a racing game. Pick a motorbike, enter Quick Race or start a new career, and aim to finish first. Use tight cornering and bold moves to push rivals aside. Tweak resolution and visual effects for smooth play. Grab a bike and hit the track today.
